annotations.title: This week vs last week, in one read

description: Use this for "how did we do this week compared with last week" (or this month, the last 30 days, any dates): one read across the brand's connected channels with every number as current, previous, change and % change — posts, reach in each platform's own unit (views, impressions or reach), engagement, engagement rate and follower change, per channel — plus a day-by-day series, the top posts and the most recent posts of the window. The previous window is always the same number of days immediately before (this_week = Monday to today against last Monday to the same weekday). Reach and engagement are never added across platforms, a number a platform does not share is unknown with the reason (never 0), and YouTube is shown without our own totals or changes (YouTube's API policy). Numbers belong to the day a post was published, so the previous window's posts have had longer to collect. Read-only, 0 credits.

account.description: one account: handle, Page name or id

brand.description: profile id/name from list_brands, this call only

channel.description: one channel: instagram, tiktok, facebook, linkedin, x, threads, youtube, pinterest, bluesky

days.description: instead of period: the last N days, 1-365

recentPosts.description: most recent posts of the window, 0-50 (default 5)

timezone.description: IANA zone for the days, e.g. America/New_York (default: the user's)

name: analytics_dashboard
